# Service dashboard — Vars

Var definitions are derived from `module.lowdefy.yaml`. Pass these via the `vars:` block in your app's `lowdefy.yaml` entry for this module.

## Summary

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `roles` | array |  | Yes | User roles that may see service status. The service-report endpoint refuses (403) a user holding none of them. List the page `{entry id}/service-status` under the app's `auth.pages.roles` with the same roles, so the menu link and the page are refused too. |
| `title` | string | `Service status` |  | Title of the page and of its menu link. |
| `top_users` | boolean | `false` |  | Show the 20 users with the most active days in the period, named from the app's own users collection (see `users`). Pelican only ever sends user ids and counts. Needs `users`; the build fails without it. |
| `users` | object |  |  | Where the app's users live, to name the top users. Needed when `top_users` is on. A user id Pelican reports that is not in the collection shows as "Unknown user". |

## Nested var details

### `users`

Where the app's users live, to name the top users. Needed when `top_users` is on. A user id Pelican reports that is not in the collection shows as "Unknown user".

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `collection` | string |  |  | The collection holding the app's users, matched on `_id` against the session user id, such as `users`. |
| `name_field` | string |  |  | Field holding the user's display name, such as `name`. |
| `company_field` | string |  |  | Field holding the user's company name, such as `profile.company_name`. Null (the default) leaves the company column out. |
